#Altcoin Performance:

Many alternative cryptocurrencies (altcoins) are not doing as well as Bitcoin. In the past month, Ethereum dropped by 22.6% and Dogecoin by 31.3%. Experts say Bitcoin is doing better partly because of new Bitcoin ETFs in the U.S.
